summary: Tested Human Coach Layer features: behavioral insights (WHY THIS HAPPENED), coach voice summaries, cross-game pattern detection, and enriched Memory tab. All 3 new endpoints work correctly. Frontend shows behavioral tags and reflection questions.

issues.description: Sub-endpoints /api/coach/deep-memory/blunder-profile, /style, /behavioral return 500 errors due to PlayerIdentityService enum validation issues when converting data from MongoDB. The main /api/coach/deep-memory endpoint works correctly by returning raw data.

seed_data_creation: None - used existing analyzed games from dev user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Human Coach Layer features fully tested. The 3 new endpoints work correctly: GET /api/analysis/{game_id}/enriched returns behavioral tags (positional_neglect, impatience, etc.), coach_summary, and cross_game_context. GET /api/coach/deep-memory returns has_data=true with blunder_taxonomy for users with analyzed games. GET /api/memory/patterns returns aggregated weakness patterns. Frontend GameSummary.jsx correctly displays WHY THIS HAPPENED section with behavioral insights. The sub-endpoints under /api/coach/deep-memory/* have enum validation issues but are not blocking.

enriched_analysis_endpoint.details: Returns behavioral tags, coach_summary (opening_line, key_observation, behavioral_insight, actionable_takeaway, encouragement), and cross_game_context (total_games_analyzed, similar_mistakes)

deep_memory_endpoint.details: Returns has_data=true, games_analyzed, identity (with blunder_taxonomy), and summary fields

memory_patterns_endpoint.details: Returns total_games, category_breakdown, top_weaknesses with examples, accuracy_trend, has_enough_data flag

frontend_behavioral_insights.details: WHY THIS HAPPENED section displays behavioral tag, short/long explanation, and reflection question

frontend_memory_tab.details: Shows Coach Memory with games count, playing style, and Blunder Profile (worst phase, most common)
